replicaCount.description: Number of slapd providers. Above 1 the nodes form a multi-master mesh over cn=config; each provider holds a full writable copy. Keep persistence.data.accessModes as ReadWriteOnce - each replica gets its own volume.

tag.description: Defaults to the chart appVersion when empty.

clusterDomain.description: Cluster DNS domain, used to build provider hostnames.

auth.description: Passwords. Supply them here or via auth.existingSecret - the chart refuses to render if neither is set, rather than deploying a directory with a default password.

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret holding the password keys. Preferred for anything real.

adminPassword.description: cn=admin password. Required unless existingSecret is set.

configPassword.description: cn=config password, used by the replication bootstrap.

replicationPassword.description: Credential the providers use to replicate to each other. Required when replication is enabled with replicaCount > 1.

ldap.description: Directory naming. Changing domain on an existing release does not rename an already-initialised database.

domain.description: DNS-style domain, e.g. example.com, rendered as dc=example,dc=com.

organization.description: Value for the o attribute on the base entry.

baseDn.description: Explicit base DN. Derived from domain when empty.

enabled.description: Configure provider-to-provider replication. Requires replicaCount > 1 to do anything.

startTLS.description: Replicate over StartTLS instead of plaintext. Requires tls.enabled and a CA both sides trust.

tlsReqCert.description: TLSVerifyClient setting for replication connections. Use demand or harder in production.

features.description: Optional OpenLDAP overlays, loaded as modules at startup.

memberOf.description: Maintain memberOf on user entries from group membership.

auditLog.description: Write an auditlog overlay to a file on the slapd volume. Only readable by a tool that shares that volume - for anything remote, prefer the accesslog overlay, which is queryable over LDAP.

monitoring.description: Enable the monitor backend so cn=Monitor reports per-database statistics.

disableAnonymousBind.description: Reject anonymous binds. Set this before exposing slapd beyond the cluster.

includeSchemas.description: Comma-separated schemas to load, e.g. cosine,inetorgperson,nis.

enabled.description: Serve LDAPS on 636 and allow StartTLS on 389.

existingSecret.description: Secret holding the certificate, key and optional CA.

caPath.description: CA bundle. Leave empty unless you need client-certificate verification.

verifyClient.description: TLSVerifyClient. never accepts any client certificate; demand requires one signed by caPath.

protocolMin.description: Minimum TLS protocol, e.g. 3.3 for TLS 1.2.

logLevel.description: slapd log level, e.g. stats, sync, acl or a numeric bitmask. Empty uses the image default.

passwordHash.description: Default password hashing scheme for userPassword.

querySizeSoft.description: sizelimit. Searches returning more than this are truncated unless the client asked otherwise.

querySizeHard.description: sizelimit hard. Cannot be exceeded by any client.

readAccessSubject.description: ACL subject granted read access, e.g. users or *.

podSecurityContext.description: slapd binds to 389, so the container keeps the capabilities it needs rather than running fully restricted.

data.description: The directory database. Losing this loses the directory.

probes.description: Startup probing is generous because a fresh provider bootstraps the database before it answers.

ingressFrom.description: Allowed ingress peers. Restrict this to the UI and to the other providers.

enabled.description: Run slapcat on a schedule into a PVC.

convergenceTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for contextCSN to converge across providers.

maxUnavailable.description: Keep this at 1. Losing quorum-like majority of providers at once is what turns a rolling upgrade into an outage.

spreadAcrossNodes.description: Require providers to land on different nodes via pod anti-affinity.
